title: GS1 Web Vocabulary
usedFor: Supply-chain identifiers (GTIN, GLN) and general product attributes. Already referenced as the `gs1:` prefix in this project's JSON-LD context.
source: Third-party vocabulary survey. GS1's own publication has not been read.
finding: The prefix IRI is already emitted by this project's JSON-LD context, together with a `gtin -> gs1:gtin` term mapping, and neither has a provenance record. That mapping is very likely correct — GS1 defines GTIN and we mean GTIN — but 'very likely correct' is the standard that put six wrong IDTA identifiers into a published crate. The claim is unverified until someone reads GS1's own definition and records it.
nextStep: Read the GS1 Web Vocabulary's published definition of `gtin`, confirm the prefix IRI resolves, and establish the licence under which term labels may be redistributed. Then the existing JSON-LD mapping can become a verified entry instead of an inherited assumption.
